entities.name: Peter III of Arborea
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Peter III of the Cappai de Bas family, was the Judge of Arborea, reigning from 1335 CE until his death in 1347 CE. He was the firstborn son and successor of Hugh II assumed the throne on his father's death.
